name: Volksbad Opening
description: The Volksbühne temporarily transforms into Volksbad as incoming artistic director Matthias Lilienthal installs a swimming pool directly in front of the building. Opening August 8, this project is both artistic statement and political provocation—a call for more public space. Free swimming is paired with workshops, social events, and a supporting program, turning the theater plaza into a temporary commons. It's radical institutional theater turned inside-out.
